children: AutoZone reported fourth-quarter net sales of $6.59 billion and diluted earnings per share of $56.05 for the 16-week period ended August 29, 2026. For fiscal 2026, the company reported net sales of $20.34 billion and diluted EPS of $152.55. Management cited tariff refunds and LIFO impacts on gross margin and continued store expansion and commercial growth as drivers of results.
Net sales (16 weeks ended Aug. 29, 2026): $6,594,879 thousand.
Gross profit (16 weeks): $3,517,728 thousand; gross margin 53.3% (up 182 basis points year-over-year).
Net income (16 weeks): $931,587 thousand; diluted EPS $56.05 (prior year diluted EPS $48.71).
Fiscal year net sales (52 weeks ended Aug. 29, 2026): $20,338,555 thousand; fiscal year net income $2,572,777 thousand; diluted EPS $152.55.
Same store sales (16 weeks): Domestic +1.6%; International +10.7%; Total Company +2.7% (Total Company constant currency +1.5%).
Store growth: opened 175 stores in the quarter (97 U.S., 68 Mexico, 10 Brazil); 374 stores opened in fiscal 2026, bringing the total to 8,031 stores.
Inventory and supply: Merchandise inventories increased to $7,735,560 thousand (inventory per store $963); net inventory per store improved to negative $107 thousand.
Commercial sales momentum: Total domestic commercial sales for the quarter $1,912,981 thousand, up 8.6% year-over-year, with average sales per program per week of $18.7.
Capital deployment: Repurchased 223 thousand shares in the quarter ($697.5 million) and 579 thousand shares in the fiscal year ($2.0 billion); $1.607 billion remaining under repurchase authorization.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: AutoZone posts Q4 revenue $6.59B, diluted EPS $56.05; FY sales $20.34B, diluted EPS $152.55
